opening: The left side of my face has gone weak.
The fevers and headaches started two weeks ago.
The face weakness, the loss of taste, the worse headache and the constant fever began about a month after I came back from Mexico.
I've lost about 10 pounds over the past 9 months.
I've lost my sense of taste.
I've been on adalimumab for my psoriatic arthritis for 6 years.

opening.text: I've been having fevers and headaches for the past two weeks, and the left side of my face has gone weak. I've also lost my sense of taste. I've lost about 10 pounds over the past 9 months. I recently travelled to Mexico, and the face weakness, the loss of taste, the worse headache and the constant fever began about a month after I came back. I've been on adalimumab for my psoriatic arthritis for 6 years.
